rows.label: Michael Myers
rows.description: fictional character in the Halloween franchise
rows.hook: returns to his Illinois hometown to stalk teenagers while hiding behind a blank white mask

rows.label: Hannibal Lecter
rows.description: fictional character created by Thomas Harris
rows.hook: is a refined former psychiatrist who advises FBI agents from inside a prison cell

rows.label: Pennywise
rows.description: main antagonist of Stephen King's novel It
rows.hook: is a shapeshifting entity that lures kids in a Maine town by appearing as a dancing clown

rows.label: Jason Voorhees
rows.description: main character of the Friday the 13th series
rows.hook: haunts a lakeside summer camp while wearing a hockey mask

rows.label: Pinhead
rows.description: fictional character from the Hellraiser series
rows.hook: is a bald, leather-clad figure whose head is studded with nails

rows.label: Freddy Krueger
rows.description: the main antagonist of the A Nightmare on Elm Street film series
rows.hook: attacks teenagers in their dreams wearing a striped sweater and a glove with blades

rows.label: Xenomorph
rows.description: fictional extraterrestrial species from the Alien film series
rows.hook: is a parasitic extraterrestrial predator that stalks a spaceship crew

rows.label: Art the Clown
rows.description: main antagonist of the Terrifier franchise

rows.label: Leatherface
rows.description: fictional character in the Texas Chainsaw Massacre franchise
rows.hook: is a hulking figure in a grisly face mask from a rural family, armed with a revving saw

rows.label: Norman Bates
rows.hook: runs a roadside motel and is dominated by his possessive mother

rows.label: Count Orlok
rows.description: title character in the film Nosferatu

rows.label: Chucky
rows.hook: is a doll possessed by a killer's soul, with a foul mouth and a knife

rows.label: Ghostface
rows.description: shared identity of the antagonists in the Scream media franchise
rows.hook: hides behind a black robe and a pale, wailing mask while taunting victims over the phone

rows.label: Jigsaw
rows.description: fictional character from the film series Saw
rows.hook: is a former engineer and architect who devises elaborate traps for his captives

rows.label: Ash Williams
rows.description: fictional character from the Evil Dead series
rows.hook: is a wisecracking hero who fights demon-possessed creatures with a chainsaw for a hand and a shotgun
